pred_texts: Instruct: First get a large pot and fill it half-way with water.
Instruct: Now put the pot of water on the stove and turn on the stove at high heat.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add two tablespoons of salt to the water.
Instruct: Now add about 200 grams of pasta to the water.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now while the pasta is boiling, take two cloves of garlic and chop them into medium-sized pieces.
Instruct: Now take a medium sized pan and add two tablespoons of olive oil to the pan.
Instruct: Now turn on the stove with the medium sized pan and set the heat to medium.
Instruct: Now add the chopped cloves of garlic to the olive oil.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now let's wait for the oil in the medium sized pan to heat up. Meanwhile, you can stir the pasta so that it is well mixed and cooks well.
Instruct: Now you can cover the pasta pot with the lid so that the water does not spill.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now wait for the oil in the medium sized pan to heat up and then turn down the heat to medium-low.
Instruct: Now wait till the pasta cooks. Make sure that the hot water in the pasta pot does not spill and the garlic in the pan does not burn.
Instruct: Now take one cup of tomato sauce and put it on the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now turn on the heat of the stove with the pan to medium and wait for the pasta in the other stove to cook.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: You can now drain the water completely from the pasta.
Instruct: Now add the pasta to the pan with the tomato sauce.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now stir the pasta and the tomato sauce so that they are well mixed.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now take around 100 grams of mozzarella cheese and chop it into very small pieces.
Instruct: Now add the chopped mozzarella to the to the pasta with the tomato sauce.
Instruct: Now turn on the heat slightly to medium and stir to mix the pasta and the mozzarella cheese well.
Instruct: While this is cooking, you can get a few basil leaves and add the basil leaves to the pasta.
Instruct: Now stir the the basil leaves together with the pasta.
Instruct: Now let's wait for around one minute until the cheese is melted. Keep on stirring the pasta.
Instruct: You can turn off the heat.
